summary: ProfileHistory is a user control for displaying and interacting with a staff member's historical records and activities in various sections such as education, training, placements, certifications, health, and more. It dynamically populates dropdown items based on the presence of data in these sections and uses a grid to display filtered history entries.
purpose: The purpose of ProfileHistory is to allow users (staff/admin) to view, filter, and print details about a staff member's profile history segmented by different categories (screen sections), enhancing recordkeeping and workflow tracking in the staff profile system.

workflows.name: Profile History Data Binding
steps: Initialize StaffPRHistoryList with current UserSession and StaffID.
Determine selected screen section from dropdown; default to ALL if none selected.
Clear dropdown items and add ALL option.
Check for existence of various entry types (Master, Profile, Training, Education, Placements, etc) in staff profile history data.
For each section with entries, add corresponding dropdown item.
Set dropdown selected value to current screen section.
Bind filtered StaffPRHistory data to grid, either all or by specified section.

workflows.name: Entry Type Detection
steps: Check if ScreenSectionUntranslated matches known types (e.g., Training, Education, Cert, Safety, etc).
If matched, acknowledge presence for dropdown population.

workflows.name: Printing Details
steps: System prepares and prints details for the current filtered profile history view.

business_rules: Only show dropdown options for screen sections present in staff history data.
Default screen section to ALL if no selection.
Filter grid data according to selected section.
validations: Validate existence of entry type before displaying in dropdown.
Ensure selected dropdown item corresponds to a valid screen section value.
Check StaffID and UserSession are present.
conditions: If dropdown selected item is null, use ALL section.
If screenSection is ALL, bind all history data; else, filter by selected section.
system_behavior: Dropdown is dynamically populated based on available data types.
Grid displays profile history either entirely or by filtered section.
Print button allows export/printing of currently displayed details.
exceptions: No entries found for a section — section is not shown in dropdown.
Invalid StaffID/UserSession — data will not bind.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling logic for invalid dropdown values or empty history data.
No information about user permissions or roles for modifying profile history.
No details about printing functionality implementation.
